scientific_objective: Independent field-out-of-fit predictive adequacy of axial diffusion and residue-specific N15 CSA assumptions versus spherical fixed CSA, for external enzyme PSE-4 measured at three fields. No inference on FN1 domain orientations.

data_source.source_authenticity: NMR-STAR v3 BMRB public raw fitted relaxation observable values
data_source.T1_T2_units: milliseconds in deposited table; transform R_s_inverse=1000/T_ms and propagate SE_R=1000*SE_T/(T_ms*T_ms); NOE dimensionless
data_source.known_limitation: PSE-4 800MHz T2 dataset has documented inconsistency in published secondary NMR diagnostics; use as honest heldout stress test not universal ground truth or proof model wrong; report separately.
data_source.literature_warning: Sébastien Morin thesis discusses BMRB6838 inconsistent 800MHz R2 and spurious Rex fits

source_gate.inclusion: ALL residues with all 9 observed positive-valued and positive-error entries; do not choose based on fit or heldout outcomes

fixed_forward_model.physics_type: 15N R1/R2/steady-state heteronuclear NOE, axial second rank rotational spectral densities; no molecular dynamics trajectories
fixed_forward_model.note: theta=45° is a preselected numerical sensitivity direction, NOT PSE-4 NH-vector orientations. No mechanistic proof of anisotropy or actual physical diffusion tensor.

models.change: isotropic ratio1; theta ignored, deltaCSA=-170ppm; fit tau_global & S2 (2 params)
as M0 but fit residue CSA (3 params)
axial theta fixed 45°, fit Dparallel/Dperp plus tau_global & S2, CSA -170ppm (3 params)
axial theta 45° fixed, fit Dparallel/Dperp and CSA plus tau,S2 (4 params)

training_objective.weighted_residual: (forward-observed)/reported_error; least squares over exactly six observations per residue; optimize scipy.optimize.least_squares(bounds) using fixed three initial seeds; choose lowest training chi2 ONLY.
training_objective.seed_extra_initials: when optional, center CSA at -170ppm and Dparallel/Dperp=1.0
training_objective.optimizer: scipy.optimize.least_squares method trf, fixed tolerance 1e-8, max_nfev=200
training_objective.uncertainty: T1/T2 error propagated first order to rates; diagonal weights as approximation, no true covariance known
training_objective.validation: DO NOT LOOK at 800MHz during optimization and model selection, including not tuning bounds, seeds or objective after seeing results.

heldout_metrics.primary: At 800MHz compute per-residue sum of squared standardized residuals over R1,R2,NOE, then median across all complete residues for each model. Compare M1,M2,M3 minus M0 on exactly same residues.
secondary: median and mean squared standardized residual per observable separately
fraction of residues with |standardized prediction residual| <=2 per heldout channel
number and share of residues for each model with ALL 3 heldout observables within 2 errors
paired per-residue counts of improved total loss vs baseline
repeat descriptive summary excluding documented compromised 800MHz R2 from only the scoring (NOT fitting) and label sensitivity; primary still includes it
heldout_metrics.statistical_limit: No p-value or claim of model superiority on genuinely independent proteins; all residues share one protein and systematic 800MHz anomaly; no posterior, calibration or inference of physical exchange
quality_gates: All prediction JSON rows include actual per-field source values/errors and per-model fitted training parameters & test residuals
Positive finite T1/T2 and uncertainties all 9
If no physically reasonable fit to training, include precomputed high residual rather than dropping that residue
Model complexity changes between variants: even heldout gain does NOT establish actual variable CSA/anisotropy without orientational data
Do not declare FN1 structural validation from PSE-4 rates

next_if_pass_or_fail: Consider more independent proteins, actual 3D NH-vector-specific diffusion tensor and clean multiple-field dataset. Do not retroactively alter test split.
